set -euo pipefail; SB=$HOME/.cache/fred-codex-helper-sandbox-20260913; rm -rf "$SB"; mkdir -p "$SB"; cat >"$SB/omega-mcp-headers" <<'PY'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ai-core-node/.config/omega/omega-mcp.env')
token=''
for line in p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
    if line.startswith('OMEGA_MCP_TOKEN='):
        token=line.split('=',1)[1].strip()
        break
if not token:
    raise SystemExit(2)
print(json.dumps({'Authorization':'Bearer '+token},separators=(',',':')))
